manifest.title: Zero velocity. Nonzero acceleration.
manifest.summary: At the top of a toss, vertical velocity reaches zero while gravity accelerates the ball downward at -g, independent of mass.
manifest.description: Left: A ball on a vertical height ruler moving under gravity with live velocity, acceleration vectors, and a force callout. Right: A velocity-time plot showing constant negative slope through v = 0 at the top.
assumptions: No air resistance, up is positive.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed or gravity, then press Play. Compare the readings at each pause near the top. Change mass while paused to compare force and acceleration.
